settings.editor:
A. BRIEF LABORATORY DESCRIPTION
RESEARCH FIELD 1. General Instrumentation 2.Medical instrumentation 3. Industrial Instrumentation 4. Defense Instrumentation 5. Sensor Technology 6. Antenna Technology 7. Telemetry and Telecontrol Systems 8. Security System 9. Radio Communication System 10. Acoustics System 11.     Sistem Audiovisual 12. Robotics and Automatic Control System 13.     Sistem Embeded   ACTIVITY 1. Practicum in the field of instrumentation for undergraduate students in Physics and Nuclear Engineering 2. Research in the field of instrumentation for undergraduate thesis students in Physics and Nuclear Engineering 3. Final Project Research for Undergraduate Thesis Students in Physics and Nuclear Engineering 4. Final Project Research for S2/S3 students 5. Lecturer Research and Collaborative Research   POTENTIAL ACTIVITIES IMPLEMENTED: 1. Development of Sensors, Detectors, Transducers 2. Telecontrol System Development 3. Development of Automatic Control Technology And Quality Test 4. Development of Medical Instrumentation 5. Defense And Security Technology 6. Acoustics system 7.         Sistem Audiovisual 8. Robotics and Automatic Control System 9.         Sistem Embeded   MAIN FACILITIES AND EQUIPMENT 1) Practicum Module Packages and Detectors, sensors and transducers 2) Telecontrol System (Antenna, VHF/UHF/HF Transceiver, Filter, Telemetry System, Filter) 3)         Sistem PSoC (Programmable System on Chip) 4) System identification, test and analysis of materials and tools. 5)         Kamera infrared 6)         Radio Communication Based Digital Data Communication Network
